product_family: AI voice generation / text-to-speech platform: WellSaid Studio (web app for script-to-voiceover production, team workspaces), Developer API (real-time TTS integration for apps, LMS, IVR), and Adobe Express/Premiere Pro integrations. Sold on Online (self-serve/consumer) and Business & Enterprise (contracted) terms.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type I
certifications.proof_quote: As part of our continuing commitment to trust and security, we are proud to maintain SOC2 Type I and SOC2 Type II certifications.' Trust center compliance list also shows 'SOC 2 Type I - 2022' and 'SOC 2 Type I Attestation' as available reports.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: We are SOC2 Type II certified and maintain compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the requirements of the EU AI Act.' Trust center resources list 'SOC 2 Type II - 2025' and 'SOC2 Type II - 2024' reports.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No vendor-domain page claims a WellSaid-held ISO 27001 certificate. The only ISO reference found is 'All our infrastructure is deployed on FINRA, HIPAA and ISO-compliant services' (www.wellsaid.io/security), which describes the underlying cloud host's compliance posture (WellSaid runs on Google Cloud Platform per its subprocessor list), not a certification WellSaid itself holds.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: Same 'FINRA, HIPAA and ISO-compliant services' sentence describes hosting infrastructure, not a WellSaid-signed Business Associate Agreement or a HIPAA compliance program of its own. No BAA, no HIPAA page, and no mention of HIPAA in the trust center's Compliance section (which lists only SOC 2 Type I/II) or in the Privacy Policy/DPA.

certifications.name: GDPR (posture)
certifications.proof_quote: WellSaid Labs is committed to protecting customer rights to privacy and prioritizes upholding the compliance standards for personal data under General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. Not mentioned on the trust center, security page, or privacy/DPA pages; the product does not process cardholder data directly (billing is not a core Studio/API function).

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. Not referenced anywhere on wellsaid.io or trust.wellsaidlabs.com.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI management system)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 42001 certification. The company instead publishes a 'CSR and Generative AI Statement' and references EU AI Act compliance, but no formal AI-governance certification is claimed.

certifications.name: CSA STAR
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. Not mentioned on any vendor-domain page reviewed.

privacy.ai_training_note: WellSaid explicitly states it does not train its (or any third party's) AI models on customer inputs/outputs: 'We do not use your inputs and outputs to train our models' / 'We do not use customer data to train our text-to-speech model, and we do not sell customer data or PII.' Voice actors used to build the base voice library are separately licensed and consented, distinct from customer-uploaded script/content data.
privacy.data_region: United States (WellSaid's Privacy Policy states the Service is hosted in the US; primary cloud subprocessor is Google Cloud Platform, US region, per the trust center subprocessor list).

security.name: Backup / recoverability
security.value: Snapshots every 24 hours; point-in-time recovery implemented

security.name: Monitoring
security.value: 24/7/365 monitoring and continuous vulnerability scanning of hosting infrastructure

security.name: Content moderation
security.value: Dual-layer content moderation (uses subprocessor Hive.ai) for output safety

security.name: Subprocessors
security.value: Google Cloud Platform (cloud storage / audio generation, US), Verisoul (user verification, US), Mixpanel (analytics, US), Hive.ai (content moderation, US)

products.name: WellSaid Studio
products.data_scope: Customer scripts/text input, generated audio, project/workspace collaboration data
products.notes: Core self-serve and team product; covered by the Online WSA for individual/self-serve customers and the Business & Enterprise WSA for contracted customers.

products.name: Developer API
products.data_scope: Text payloads sent for synthesis, returned audio; integrated into third-party apps, LMS platforms, IVRs
products.notes: Same underlying data-handling and no-training commitments as Studio per the Privacy Policy/DPA, which apply platform-wide.

products.name: Adobe Express / Premiere Pro integrations
products.data_scope: Script and audio pass-through between Adobe tools and WellSaid
products.notes: No integration-specific security disclosures found beyond the general platform security page.

compare.pricing_model: Tiered SaaS: self-serve/online plans (individual, small team) plus negotiated Business & Enterprise agreements; also a metered Developer API.
compare.data_residency: United States (hosted on Google Cloud Platform, US region)

flags: The security page states infrastructure is 'deployed on FINRA, HIPAA and ISO-compliant services,' which could be mistaken for WellSaid itself holding HIPAA or ISO 27001 certification. The trust center's own Compliance section lists only SOC 2 Type I/II; this is a hosting-provider characteristic, not a WellSaid-held certification.

Two independent vendor-domain sources agree on SOC 2 Type I/II: the trust center lists 'SOC 2 Type II - 2025', 'SOC2 Type II - 2024', and 'SOC 2 Type I - 2022' report editions, corroborated by www.wellsaid.io/security.
No ISO 27001, HIPAA BAA, PCI DSS, FedRAMP, ISO 42001, or CSA STAR held by WellSaid itself; treat any customer-facing claim beyond SOC 2 + GDPR with caution.
